name: Hope of Ghirapur
oracle_text:
Flying
Sacrifice Hope of Ghirapur: Until your next turn, target player who was dealt combat damage by Hope of Ghirapur this turn can't cast noncreature spells.
blocked_sentences: Sacrifice Hope of Ghirapur: Until your next turn, target player who was dealt combat damage by Hope of Ghirapur this turn can't cast noncreature spells.

needs.what: a one-shot op (or an `affects_spells` option on the timed CastLock) that stops the named player(s) from casting spells matching a spell filter -- here `{"not_types": ["Creature"]}` -- until the controller's next turn, so an activated ability on a sacrificed permanent can leave the lock behind
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `cant_cast_spells` with `affects_spells` is a static_effect, so it lives only while its permanent does and dies with the sacrificed source; the timed op `cant_cast_spells_from_zones` has the right clock (`duration: until_your_next_turn`) and `player`, but filters only by zone (`zones`/`except_zones`), not by spell type, so it would forbid creature spells too or nothing at all

needs.what: a player target spec restricted to players this source dealt combat damage to this turn (the `{"dealt_combat_damage_by": "self"}` set), legal to choose as a target and checked again on resolution; it must read the ledger of the source as it was before it was sacrificed as the cost
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `{"dealt_combat_damage_by": "self"}` is a player spec usable as an effect's `player` or a selector's `controller`, not a restriction on which player may be TARGETED; and its record is keyed by the source oid, which the sacrifice cost removes from the battlefield before targets are legal-checked
